usageNotes: Use this to list all QEMU VMs on a specific node, including their run state, resource usage, and tags. Only VMs where the caller has VM.Audit permission on /vms/<vmid> are returned — partial lists are normal in multi-tenant clusters. Pass full=true to include live CPU/memory/disk/network stats for running VMs; omitting it returns a lighter response suitable for inventory enumeration.

examples.summary: List all VMs on node 'pve1' with full runtime stats

tips: Results are scoped per-node; call this for each node in the cluster to build a cluster-wide VM inventory.
The 'status' field reflects the QEMU process state (stopped/running); 'qmpstatus' gives finer-grained QMP state (e.g. 'paused') for running VMs.
template=true entries are VM templates — filter these out if you only want live or startable VMs.
The 'lock' field indicates a config lock (e.g. 'migrate', 'backup', 'snapshot') — avoid config changes or migrations on locked VMs.
disk/net counters (diskread, diskwrite, netin, netout) are cumulative since guest start, not per-second rates; compute deltas between polls for throughput.
